title: fix(objectql)!: a roll-up summary field is read-only on update whether or not it declares readonly: true
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-support-ai"} -->
_Requested by **Yibo Wang** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01BVUyyPie8gHwoPM18iABwB?thread=cmsg_01BVUyyPie8gHwoPM18iABwBFyg5B2muWbKZjA9phXVWse)_

Part of #34672 (the update side; the create side stays open on the card, scope note 6949162788)

Clause-②: no (narrowing)
Metadata-protocol: none
Skills-docs: none — skills/** teaches `readonly: true` and summary fields but says nothing on what an update does with a value sent for a summary field; `content/docs/data-modeling/fields.mdx` now states it

## 维护者速读

- 改了什么：汇总字段（`Field.summary`）在更新时一律只读，不管作者有没有写 `readonly: true`。人用 PATCH 改、导入用 `writeMode: 'update'` 改、批量条件更新改、更新预览，送来的汇总值都被丢掉，其余字段照写，`droppedFields` 里报 `readonly`；开了 `strictReadonlyWrites` 则整笔拒收。
- 为什么改：卡上实测 18.5.0 里销售能把「累计已转吨数」「实际成交额」「客户订单合计」直接改成任意数，存下来被下游读，直到下次子记录变动才被重算覆盖。汇总值是引擎算的，不该能手填。
- 风险与回滚：收窄（BREAKING）：今天能写进汇总字段的非系统更新会被丢或被拒。系统上下文（`isSystem`）照写，汇总重算本身就是这条路，不受影响。新建记录时带的初值照旧保留（种子数据、历史导入的预算合计，按 #6014 的既有设计）。
- 仍未覆盖：普通用户新建记录时，仍可给没写 `readonly: true` 的汇总字段带一个初值，直到下一次子记录变动重算为止；这一半留在 #34672 继续处理（席位 6949162788），所以本 PR 写 `Part of #34672`，卡不随合并关闭。回滚即撤回本 PR，无数据迁移。
- 先看：`packages/objectql/src/engine-top-level.ts`（`updateStaticReadonlySubject` 与新的 `summaryFieldsLockedOnUpdate`）、`packages/objectql/src/engine-summary-update-lock.test.ts`、`packages/rest/src/import-summary-update-lock-34672.test.ts`。
- 两分钟验证：`pnpm --filter @objectstack/objectql exec vitest run --maxWorkers=2 src/engine-summary-update-lock.test.ts`，预期 11 条全过；把 `engine-top-level.ts` 里 `summaryFieldsLockedOnUpdate(schema)` 换成 `[]` 后其中 5 条变红。
- 需要你做的：无。`check-governed-merges` 判定非受管，L1 与契约复审通过后由区自行落地。

## What changes

A roll-up `summary` field is read-only on update whether or not the author declared `readonly: true`.

- `packages/objectql/src/engine-top-level.ts`
  - `updateStaticReadonlySubject(schema, wallJudgesOrganization)` is the one schema view every update-side static `readonly` pass judges: the pre-hook hide pass (`engine-update.ts`, what `beforeUpdate` is shown), the by-id strip and the predicate (`multi`) strip (what is stored), `staticReadonlyStoredView` (read by the `readonlyWhen` strips and the master-detail settlement), and the `update`-mode preview in `engine-validate.ts`. It now also reads every `summary` field as `readonly: true`. So all five take the same key, report it through `onFieldsDropped` / `droppedFields` with reason `readonly`, and refuse it under `strictReadonlyWrites` (`ERR_READONLY_FIELD_REJECTED`).
  - New export `summaryFieldsLockedOnUpdate(schema)`: the `summary` fields not already declared `readonly: true`, keyed on `type === 'summary'` literally.
  - The `stripComputedWriteFields` doc points at the new lock: that door runs in every context, so it would also take the recompute's own write; this one exempts `isSystem`.
- `content/docs/data-modeling/fields.mdx`: one paragraph under the summary field section.
- `.changeset/34672-summary-readonly-on-update.md`: `patch` on `@objectstack/objectql`, BREAKING, the one-line fix, ADR-0087 `not-required (no-migration-prescription)`.

No new drop reason, no spec key: reason `readonly`, as `autonumber` already rides it without the flag (#5503).

## Why

The card measured on 18.5.0: a sales rep's `PATCH` of `crm_quote_line_item.cb_converted_quantity` stored `90` with no order behind it; a manager's `PATCH` or an import update moved `crm_opportunity.cb_actual_won_amount` from `619469.03` to `2`; `crm_account.cb_order_amount` took `55`. Each value stayed until a child write recomputed the roll-up, and downstream defaults read it. The spec already says `summary` is "never client-written" (`COMPUTED_VALUE_TYPES`); the update path did not enforce it.

Why the `readonly` strip and not the `computed` door: `stripComputedWriteFields` runs in every context, `isSystem` included, so it would also take the roll-up recompute's write (`recomputeSummaries` writes the parent through `update()` with `isSystem: true` and `SUMMARY_RECOMPUTE_WRITE`), and the spec describes `computed` as a formula with no column. The static `readonly` strip already skips `isSystem` writes (`staticReadonlyStripRuns = !isSystem`), so the recompute, the backfill and the enable refresh keep writing without reading the marker.

Insert is NOT narrowed. A create keeps a caller's value as the field's starting value. The `summary` note on `RUNTIME_OWNED_FIELD_TYPES` (`packages/objectql/src/validation/rule-validator.ts`, the #6014 note) keeps the type out of the insert-side strip on purpose: seed data and a historical import may carry a pre-computed total, and `initializeSummaryFields` seeds only the roll-ups the caller left out. This PR does not overturn it; the insert half is reported to the seat as a finding.

## Tests

- `packages/objectql/src/engine-summary-update-lock.test.ts` (new, 11 cases), one account whose `order_total` is a `sum` roll-up with no `readonly`, beside the same roll-up declared `readonly: true`, written as a signed-in person:
  - by-id update (the PATCH door): the roll-up is dropped and reported as `readonly`, the rest of the payload is written;
  - predicate update (`multi: true`): dropped from every matched row, reported once;
  - `strictReadonlyWrites`: by-id and predicate both refused (`code` `ERR_READONLY_FIELD_REJECTED`, `fields`, `drops`, `operation`), nothing written;
  - the `update`-mode preview reports the same drop;
  - the next child write recomputes the roll-up after a dropped write;
  - an `isSystem` write of the column is kept;
  - CONTROL: the declared `readonly: true` roll-up answers the same, and a payload naming both reports both in one event;
  - insert keeps a caller's initial value;
  - two unit pins on `summaryFieldsLockedOnUpdate`.
- `packages/rest/src/import-summary-update-lock-34672.test.ts` (new, 3 cases), real ObjectQL + protocol + SQLite `:memory:` through the HTTP routes as a signed-in person: `PATCH /api/v1/data/:object/:id`; `POST /api/v1/data/:object/import` with `writeMode: 'update'`, dry run and commit (each row's `droppedFields` and the stored value); the declared `readonly: true` control on both doors.
- Changed tests (forced by the narrowing), the two #20308 blank-typed-value pins. Each sends a blank for every typed column, `f_summary` included, and asserted each lands `null`. On update the `summary` blank is now dropped, so:
  - `packages/objectql/src/engine-blank-typed-value-door.test.ts`, case "update by id and update by predicate": every other typed column reaches the driver as `null`, and no `f_summary` is sent;
  - `packages/rest/src/rest-data-blank-typed-value.test.ts` (SQLite), the PATCH, batch update and updateMany doors: every other typed column stores `null`, and `f_summary` keeps its seeded `7`.
  - The insert / create cases of both files are unchanged.

Ablation (`node scripts/ablation-replace.mjs`, on 7aebcc32): `const rollUps = summaryFieldsLockedOnUpdate(schema);` replaced by `const rollUps: string[] = [];` (anchor x1 → x0, blob `c112f3aea19e` → `b4d66f559710`). The suites import the engine from source. Result: `Tests 6 failed | 14 passed (20)`.
- Red, as predicted: by-id, predicate, strict, preview, CONTROL (the undeclared roll-up is stored), and the forced blank-door case.
- Green, as predicted: the baseline, the recompute, `isSystem`, insert and the two unit pins.
- Restore: blob `c112f3aea19e` == HEAD, `git diff HEAD` empty.

## Acceptance notes

- Started from `main` while PR #34709 (#34465, same area, edits `engine-update.ts`) is still open, on the seat's go-ahead; this PR edits no line of `engine-update.ts`. `git merge-tree --write-tree` of 7aebcc32 against #34709's head `13741cb9` and against #34565's head `779d1aa3`: both exit 0. #34565 then landed and `main` (6091b645) is merged here (65f7837f). Against #34709's current head `18f3774a`, `git merge-tree --write-tree` of the final head 76acd4f2 exits 0. Whichever of #34709 and this PR lands second merges `main` and re-runs the affected pins.
- The file surface grew twice in the area's records on the card: one new test file under `packages/rest/src` (the import door end to end), and the forced change to `packages/rest/src/rest-data-blank-typed-value.test.ts`.
- The insert half (a person's `POST` with a summary value is kept until the next child write) is NOT outside the card: its Expected covers creates too (seat contract review delta 6949128257, scope note corrected on #34672 as 6949162788). It is deferred, so this PR is `Part of #34672` and the card stays open for the create side.
- Update-side answers, written in the changeset and in `content/docs/data-modeling/fields.mdx` by `91202760` (prose only, over the reviewed head `76acd4f2`): an import with `writeMode: 'upsert'` drops a summary value on the rows it updates and keeps it on the rows it creates; a historical import (`treatAsHistorical: true`, writing with `preserveAudit`) keeps the value on update, as it keeps any other read-only value it sends; undoing an ordinary import restores rows through an ordinary update, so a summary value an import committed before this rule is not put back by the undo and stays until the next child write recomputes it.
- The strict refusal's per-reason phrase for `readonly` reads "read-only (`readonly: true`)". It already covers `autonumber` without the flag; it now covers `summary` too. Unchanged here: it shows only on a refusal that mixes reasons.
